patterns.name: Hammer
patterns.text: After a fall, a small body near the top of the day's range with a long lower shadow at least twice the body: sellers pushed the price down and buyers brought it back.

patterns.name: Inverted hammer
patterns.text: After a fall, a small body near the bottom of the range with a long upper shadow at least twice the body.

patterns.name: Bullish engulfing
patterns.text: After a fall, a red candle followed by a bigger green candle whose body covers the red body.

patterns.name: Piercing line
patterns.text: After a fall, a long red candle, then a green candle that opens below the red close and closes above the middle of the red body.

patterns.name: Bullish harami
patterns.text: After a fall, a long red candle followed by a small green candle whose body sits inside the red body.

patterns.name: Morning star
patterns.text: After a fall, a long red candle, a small candle below it, then a green candle closing above the middle of the first.

patterns.name: Three white soldiers
patterns.text: Three solid green candles in a row, each opening inside the previous body and closing higher, near the day's high.

patterns.name: Dragonfly doji
patterns.text: After a fall, open and close at about the same price near the day's high, with a long lower shadow.

patterns.name: Doji after a fall
patterns.text: After a fall, a candle whose open and close are almost the same (indecision), on a normal-sized range.

patterns.name: Bullish marubozu
patterns.text: A long green candle with almost no shadows: it opened near the low and closed near the high.

patterns.name: Tweezer bottom
patterns.text: After a fall, a red candle and a green candle with the same low (within 0.2%).

patterns.name: Three inside up
patterns.text: A bullish harami followed by a third green candle closing above the first candle's open.

patterns.name: Shooting star
patterns.text: After a rise, a small body near the bottom of the range with a long upper shadow at least twice the body: buyers pushed up and sellers took it back.

patterns.name: Hanging man
patterns.text: After a rise, the hammer shape: small body near the top, long lower shadow.

patterns.name: Bearish engulfing
patterns.text: After a rise, a green candle followed by a bigger red candle whose body covers the green body.

patterns.name: Dark cloud cover
patterns.text: After a rise, a long green candle, then a red candle that opens above the green close and closes below the middle of the green body.

patterns.name: Bearish harami
patterns.text: After a rise, a long green candle followed by a small red candle whose body sits inside the green body.

patterns.name: Evening star
patterns.text: After a rise, a long green candle, a small candle above it, then a red candle closing below the middle of the first.

patterns.name: Three black crows
patterns.text: Three solid red candles in a row, each opening inside the previous body and closing lower, near the day's low.

patterns.name: Gravestone doji
patterns.text: After a rise, open and close at about the same price near the day's low, with a long upper shadow.

contexts.uptrend: In an uptrend (above a rising 200-day average)
contexts.downtrend: In a downtrend (below a falling 200-day average)
